criteria.requirement: The 3D Sun/Earth/Moon layout and day slider implement a visibly simplified 29.5-day cycle labeled not to scale.
criteria.action: Inspect the model, cycle label and day slider endpoints.
criteria.expected: Sun, Earth and Moon form a 3D lesson with a simplified 29.5-day cycle labeled not to scale.

criteria.requirement: Earth-view illumination and phase names agree at new, first quarter, full and last quarter; phases arise from solar illumination rather than Earth shadow.
criteria.action: Visit new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter; compare lighting and the Earth-view disk.
criteria.expected: Names and disk illumination agree with each phase; the Moon is illuminated by the Sun rather than covered by Earth's shadow.

criteria.requirement: Play/pause, four phase buttons and reset update both model and Earth-view preview; intermediate waxing/waning phases remain coherent.
criteria.action: Use play/pause, each phase button and reset; inspect intermediate waxing and waning days.
criteria.expected: Orbit position, phase name and separate preview update consistently and reset restores the initial state.

criteria.requirement: A three-question quiz provides feedback and retry, illustrating answers through the model.
criteria.action: Answer all three quiz questions, including a mistake, and retry.
criteria.expected: Three questions provide feedback and model-based illustrations, with another attempt available.

criteria.requirement: Keyboard controls reach every phase without scene dragging, mobile labels remain readable and reduced-motion preference starts playback paused.
criteria.action: Explore all phases by keyboard, inspect a phone layout and open with reduced motion.
criteria.expected: No dragging is needed, labels remain readable, mobile sections stack sensibly and reduced-motion playback starts paused.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the model, Earth-view preview, cycle and scale explanation.
Visit all four key phases plus an intermediate waxing and waning phase, then exercise play/pause/reset.
Answer a quiz question incorrectly and retry; inspect keyboard access and a reduced-motion context if the harness supports it, otherwise report that limitation.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
